name: aspect-ratio
title: Aspect Ratio
description: A box that keeps its width-to-height ratio while its width changes. Exactly shadcn's; the hand-made part is what surrounds it: a photograph on a Polaroid, a print taped at its corners, a map pinned to the desk.

a11y: Layout only: no role, no name, no keyboard behavior. Give the image inside it real alt text, or an empty alt if it is decoration.
The frames in the examples (a Polaroid's white border, tape, a pin) are decoration and hidden from assistive tech; the caption is real text.
A ratio box has no minimum height, so it collapses to nothing in a container that has no width: give the parent one.
